profile.themes: Aviation Infrastructure Electrification; RDSS Modernization; EHV Entry; In-House Panel & Busway Manufacturing

bull_bear.body: Prioritizing internal accruals for working capital; no fresh equity/debt planned for FY26; Peaton acquisition funded via existing cash; future capex tied to order execution velocity
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Monsoon delays impacting installation timelines; receivables still at 87 days (vs target 80); execution capacity strain if order book grows beyond INR500cr; Peaton integration delays; regulatory delays in tender openings
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly confident, execution-focused, and vertically integrated; emphasized 50-year milestone as springboard; clear roadmap for 50%+ CAGR; proactive on partnerships and in-house innovation
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Peaton’s Siemens/Rittal licenses unlock premium pricing and access to government-approved vendor lists; busway product is already proven in Vodafone data center (2-year run) — not theoretical; RDSS Phase 2 (underground cabling) is a multi-year INR30kcr opportunity beyond Phase 1 loss reduction
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Aviation: Udaipur Airport (INR57.89cr); RDSS: Ajmer Vidyut (INR70.55cr); EHV: bidding for 400kV projects; Manufacturing: Peaton (INR34cr FY25 rev, 7-8% EBITDA); Busway: in final testing for data centers/high-rises
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: Q1 margin depressed by supply-heavy mix and monsoon delays; full-year target 13-15% via higher installation billing; Peaton margins expected to improve from 7-8% to 10%+ via Siemens/Rittal co-branding and cost optimization
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: 50%+ YoY for FY26; margin: targeting 13-15% EBITDA by year-end; order inflow: targeting 2x revenue; capex/commissioning: Peaton integration (Q2FY26), busway testing (Sep 2025)
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: INR400cr (includes INR70.55cr RDSS Ajmer, INR57.89cr Udaipur Airport, INR80.24cr Godrej Khavda; bid pipeline ~INR400cr)
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Entry into EHV transmission; scaling Peaton to INR100cr+ in 2 years; busway launch for data centers/high-rises; geographic expansion to NE India; JV bidding for INR300cr+ tenders
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Strong Q1 revenue growth (59.8% YoY) and order wins in aviation and RDSS signal accelerated execution momentum; the upcoming Peaton acquisition closure and in-house busway launch are key catalysts to unlock margin expansion and vertical integration benefits.

meta.thesis: Strong Q1 revenue growth (59.8% YoY) and order wins in aviation and RDSS signal accelerated execution momentum; the upcoming Peaton acquisition closure and in-house busway launch are key catalysts to unlock margin expansion and vertical integration benefits.
